greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNdodana, nelikaMoya Oyingcwele. Makube nguxolo lukaKristu olunikhapheli namhlanje, lusomeleza sonke kulokuqokelelana kwethu.
penitential:
Nkosi, yiba nenceba nathi.
Kristu, yiba nenceba nathi.
Nkosi, yiba nenceba nathi.
homily: Kukhona ixesha elibekiweyo layo yonke into phantsi sezulu. UQoheleth usitshela namhlanje ukuba kukho ixesha lokuzalwa, nexesha lokufa; ixesha lokulila, nexesha lokuhleka; ixesha lokuzilela, nexesha lokungcungca. Ukuba uyayivula ingqondo yakho kulamazwi, uya kuva ukuba ubomi bethu abuyonto yengozi nje engenasiphelo, kodwa buyinkqubo enobunzulu obungenakulinganiswa. Mhlawumbi namhlanje, njengoko uhleli apha okanye ulalele kude, ungabona umfanekiso othile omncinci kwindlu yakho. Mhlawumbi zizicathulo ezishiywe emnyango, okanye iphepha elincinci lokutsala iindiza elinesigxiviso sokuba umntwana wakho wayesakha indiza yakhe yamaphupha. Ben, uBenjamin Vo, wayehlala ethatha ixesha lakhe ukujonga indlela izinto ezisebenza ngayo. Wayebukela izibhakabhaka, ezoba imizila yezindiza, kwaye eneenjongo ezinkulu ngobomi bakhe. Kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayeyizalisile indlu yenu ngale mbono yobubele obumsulwa. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba sele kuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye, kwaye indlu isenokuziva ithule ngendlela ebuhlungu kakhulu. Xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana owayeza kuwe ekuseni, esithi 'Molo, Ba,' ngesandla esithembaneyo, akukho xesha lonyaka linokuzisa ukuthula ngokukhawuleza. Usizi alulandeli ikhalenda. Luza ngexesha lalo, lunzima, lufuna indawo. Ndaye ndifuna ukuba uthethe inyaniso yale ntliziyo yakho namhlanje. Akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje, kuba iNkosi ayisigwebi ngezifo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphhandle kwamandla ethu onke, kwaye akukho buqili bomntu obunokukuthintela oku. Unalo uthando lukaThixo, kwaye uBen, uBen owayesoloko elungele ukunika, ukunika konke ngaphandle kokubala—njengaleyo mali yasebhange ayefuna ukuyinika umalume wakhe uWilliam ngaphandle kokuba ayiphule—uqhubeka enibukele ngothando olungagungqiyo. KwiVangeli, uYesu uyazibuza kubafundi bakhe: 'Abantu bathi ndiybani na?' Kwaye uPetros uyaphendula: 'UnguKristu kaThixo.' UYesu uya phambili achaze ukuba uNyana womuntu kufuneka ahlupheke kakhulu, alandulelwe, abulawe, kodwa ngomhla wesithathu avuke. Apha kulapho intliziyo yethu idibana khona nelizwi likaThixo. UYesu akabalekeli intlungu; uyayinqumla. Uyathatha usizi lwenu, Alan noThao, alufake ezandleni zakhe. Ryan, mfowethu omncane, ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe, ekukhathalele, kwaye uthando lwenu aluzange lufe. Vumela uYesu abe lulwalwa lwakho namhlanje. Thatha igama likaBen, thandaza kuye uThixo, kwaye uqhubeke uphila ngesibindi, wazi ukuba akukho lizwi linye lothando olulahlekileyo phambi koThixo. Amen.
petitions: Sikhuleka kuThixo uSomandla, simcela ukuba aphulaphule izibongo zethu.
standing_petitions: Sikhulekela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abasebenzi bakaThixo abahamba phambili kwethu, ukuba baphumle ekukhanyeni kwaye bafumane uxolo olungunaphakade eBankqweni yaseZulwini.
Sikhulekela bonke abazali nabantwana abasiziweyo nabathwele imithwalo enzima, ukuba uThixo abathuthuzele abanike amandla namasiba athemba kelanga litsha.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Kukho ixesha elibekiweyo layo yonke into, nexesha layo yonke into phantsi sezulu. Ixesha lokuzalwa, nexesha lokufa; ixesha lokutyala, nexesha lokunqula okutyaliweyo. Ixesha lokubulala, nexesha lokuphilisa; ixesha lokudiliza, nexesha lokwakha. Ixesha lokila, nexesha lokuhleka; ixesha lokuzilela, nexesha lokungcungca. Ixesha lokusakaza amatye, nexesha lokuwahlanganisa; ixesha lokwamkela, nexesha lokuzilela ukwamkela. Ixesha lokufuna, nexesha lokulahlekelwa; ixesha lokugcina, nexesha lokuphosela kude. Ixesha lokukrazula, nexesha lokuthunga; ixesha lokuthi cwaka, nexesha lokuthetha. Ixesha lothando, nexesha lokuqina; ixesha lemfazwe, nexesha loxolo. Yintoni inzuzo yomsebenzi kumsebenzi wakhe? Ndiyibonisile imisebenzi eyabelwe nguThixo abantwana babantu ukuba baxakeke yiyo. Uthe zenze zonke izinto zifanele ixesha lazo, wabeka naphakade ezintliziyweni zabo, ngaphandle kokuba umntu afumanise, ukususela ekuqaleni kuye ekugqibeleni, umsebenzi owenziwe nguThixo.

readings.label: INdumiso yokuphendula
readings.text:
Makabongwe uThixo, uLwalwa lwam!
Yehova, ulwalwa lwam, iqabane lam nenqaba yam,
inyibela yam, umsindisi wam,
ukhuseleko lwam endithembela kulo.
R. Makabongwe uThixo, uLwalwa lwam!
Yehova, yintoni umntu ukuba umkhumbule;
nyana womntu ukuba umnake?
Umntu unjengomoya ophefumlayo;
imihla yakhe injengesithunzi esidlulayo.
R. Makabongwe uThixo, uLwalwa lwam!

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Kwathi kanti akuba ethandaza yedwa uYesu, benaye abafundi bakhe, wababuza esithi, 'Abantu bathi ndiybani na?' Baphendula bathi, 'UJohane umbhaptizi; abanye bathi nguEliya; abanye bathi uvukile umprofeti wamandulo.' Wathi kubo, 'Ke nina nithi ndiybani na?' UPetros waphendula wathi, 'UnguKristu kaThixo.' Wayala kubo, wabaqhwabela ukuba bangaxeleli bani oku. Wathi, 'Kufuneka uNyana womuntu ahlupheke kakhulu, alandulelwe ngabadala, nabaphristi abakhulu, nababhali, abulawe, alusuku lwesithathu avuswe.'

spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukho kwiSakramente eliNgcwele leAltare. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba nawe emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ukwamkela ngoku ngokomzimba, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngokomoya. Ndiyamkela njengokuba sele ukhona apha, kwaye ndizinikela kuwe ngokuphelele. Mus' ukuyeka ndahluke kuwe naphakade. Amen.
closing: Makube nguxolo lukaThixo olugcina iintliziyo zenu nengqondo yenu kuYesu Kristu namhla naphakade. Amen.
day: Friday of the Twenty-fifth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
